faults.detail: The child is asked "Chaar barabar tukde banao" (cut the bar into 4 equal parts), but the bar already shows three evenly spaced tick marks at exactly the equal cut points (measured on l1366: the bar runs about x 330-800, marks near x 445, 563, 680, so four segments of about 117 px each). The child only has to swipe on the drawn lines, so the hint gives the answer. The same holds for the 1/3, 1/2 and "Sahi hissa" waves, which also have "marks": true. This also blunts rubric item 2: a child who believes the parts "need not be equal" just follows the lines and never has to judge size, so the mix-up is never tested.
